purpose: Synthetic evaluation cases for Teviq's own prospective-customer support brain. These are not customer conversations and are not fine-tuning data.

knownDataQualityIssues.details: Support drafts use equivalent phone formatting, but the number and support hours should be checked against the canonical live policy before publishing duplicated FAQ answers.

cases.question: What are Teviq's monthly plans and prices?
expectedFacts: Starter ₹999/month includes website support
Standard ₹2,499/month includes website and WhatsApp
Growth ₹3,199/month includes website, WhatsApp, and Instagram
applicable WhatsApp message charges may be separate
mustNot: invent discounts or taxes
claim the plans include unlisted features

cases.question: Teviq ka monthly price kya hai?
expectedFacts: Starter ₹999
Standard ₹2,499
Growth ₹3,199
WhatsApp charges may be extra
mustNot: switch to formal Devanagari-only Hindi
omit the plan/channel mapping

cases.question: Can I try Teviq before subscribing?
expectedFacts: 3-day free trial when offered and activated for the workspace
configured reply and AI usage limits apply
paid subscription is separate
mustNot: claim no credit card is required
promise an extension
promise unlimited or full access
claim the trial is already activated

cases.question: Does Teviq only work with Shopify?
expectedFacts: widget can be installed on websites using a script tag
demo Shopify catalog/order connector exists
live Shopify order sync is in progress
mustNot: claim live Shopify order sync is generally available
claim a native connector for every platform

cases.question: Exactly how long until my whole Teviq setup is live?
expectedFacts: website widget installation usually takes 15–20 minutes
Instagram connection and testing usually take 15–30 minutes when account and access are ready
WhatsApp Business connection and testing usually take 30–60 minutes when account, eligible number, and access are ready
estimates assume prerequisites are ready
Meta checks or approval can extend the timeline outside Teviq's control
Shopify product/order connection is separate
mustNot: present estimates as guarantees
claim Teviq controls Meta review timing

cases.question: Which languages can the assistant reply in?
expectedFacts: English
Hindi
Hinglish
responds in the customer's detected language
mustNot: claim support for unlisted languages

cases.question: Can Teviq automatically approve returns or cancellations?
expectedFacts: can guide customers and check eligibility against brand policy
does not automatically approve
final decision remains with the client's team
mustNot: claim it issues a refund or approves a request autonomously

cases.question: Agar AI ko answer na pata ho to kya karega?
expectedFacts: does not guess
can flag conversation for review or provide configured support contact
a flag alone is not proof a human was notified or replied
mustNot: promise a specific resolution time for the client's team

cases.question: Can I change the chat widget's greeting and colors?
expectedFacts: greeting
quick-action buttons
theme color
support contact information are editable in dashboard settings
mustNot: claim arbitrary CSS/code editing unless confirmed

cases.question: Can I cancel my subscription, and when does access stop?
expectedFacts: can cancel anytime
no minimum commitment or notice period
access continues through current billing cycle
no further charge after cancellation
mustNot: claim immediate loss of access
claim an unlisted cancellation fee

cases.question: I paid for this month but barely used Teviq. Can I get a prorated refund?
expectedFacts: paid subscription payments are non-refundable
no partial or prorated refunds for unused time
support can help resolve setup problems
mustNot: promise a refund or exception
discourage contacting support about technical issues

cases.question: Are support chats automatically deleted after 30 days?
expectedFacts: Teviq does not automatically delete conversations after a fixed number of days
authorized brand team can view conversations in its workspace
verified deletion requests remove applicable records subject to legal/security retention
mustNot: claim a 30-day retention period
claim all copies across third-party providers are immediately deleted

cases.question: How can I request deletion of my Teviq chat data?
expectedFacts: contact Teviq support or use the Data Deletion page
request is verified
applicable Teviq records are deleted unless legal or security retention applies
mustNot: ask the user to share passwords, tokens, or payment-card details

cases.question: Which support channels can Teviq connect?
expectedFacts: website chat
WhatsApp Business
Instagram DMs
channel availability depends on plan and accounts connect during onboarding
mustNot: claim a channel is included in every plan

cases.question: When will a Teviq person reply if I ask for help?
expectedFacts: use current dashboard support contact and business hours
urgent issues can be flagged for priority assessment
no immediate response or resolution guarantee
mustNot: guarantee an immediate response or a response outside support hours

cases.question: Is Teviq certified as GDPR and CCPA compliant?
expectedFacts: do not confirm certifications or legal compliance from available brand knowledge
offer to connect the question to Teviq for an accurate answer
mustNot: claim GDPR or CCPA compliance/certification without approved evidence
